source: Talent names and Perfect text from the Division Fandom page Talents/Tom Clancy's The Division 2, plus Boiling Point and Precision Strike from the Red Horizon and TU22 pages. A blank text means that row had no normal description in the table.

details.name: Allegro
details.text: +12% Fire Rate
details.perfectText: Invisible Hand

details.name: Back and Forth
details.text:
Swapping to this weapon grants +10% Rate of Fire and +9% Weapon Damage for 10s.
Swapping from this weapon grants +5% Rate of Fire and +4.5% Weapon Damage for 10s. Receiving one of the bonuses will remove the previous one if it's still active. Two instances of this Talent will not function at the same time.
details.perfectText:
Swapping to this weapon grants +13% Rate of Fire and +12% Weapon Damage for 10s.
Swapping from this weapon grants +5% Rate of Fire and +4.5% Weapon Damage for 10s. Receiving one of the bonuses will remove the previous one if it's still active. Two instances of this Talent will not function at the same time.

details.name: Behind You
details.text: Amplifies weapon damage by +20% to enemies that are not targeting you.
details.perfectText: Amplifies weapon damage by +25% to enemies that are not targeting you.

details.name: Boomerang
details.text: Critical hits have a 50% chance to return the bullet to the magazine. If a bullet is returned to the magazine the next shot has +40% increased damage.

details.name: Boiling Point
details.text: The first 53% of your magazine will have -100% Critical Hit Chance. The rest will have 100%.

details.text: Landing body shots adds a stack of bonus +55% headshot damage to the next headshot for 10 seconds. Max stack is 3.
details.perfectText: Landing body shots adds a stack of bonus +70% headshot damage to the next headshot for 10s. Max stack is 2.

details.text: Killing a target within 7 meters grants +30% weapon damage for 10 seconds.
details.perfectText: Killing a target within 7 meters grants +38% weapon damage for 10 seconds.

details.name: Determined
details.text: After killing an enemy with a headshot the next shot landed on any enemy will be a guaranteed headshot.
details.perfectText: After killing an enemy with a headshot the next shot landed on any enemy will be a guaranteed critical headshot. While the talent is active killing an enemy will not retrigger the talent.

details.perfectText: Swapping from this weapon within 10 seconds of killing an enemy grants 35% critical hit chance and 40% critical hit damage for 15 seconds.

details.name: First Blood
details.text: If scoped, your first shot fired from out of combat or after fully reloading from empty deals headshot damage to any part of the body hit.
details.perfectText: If Scoped, your first two shots from out of combat or after fully reloading from empty deals headshot damage to any part of the body hit.

details.perfectText: For every 8 bullets in the magazine capacity, gain +3% rate of fire and +3% weapon damage for 5 seconds when reloading from empty.

Hitting an enemy grants +15% skill damage for 5 seconds.
